ground_truth_protocol.description: MMS over ISO-on-TCP (TCP/102): TPKT/COTP, session data-transfer SPDUs, presentation and the BER-encoded MMS PDU whose PDU type and service select the message type. BER tag, length and primitive value octets are separate fields where their offsets are fixed within a type. Derived from the Wireshark/tshark dissection of the benchmark capture (dol/truth-file-derivation/scripts/build_truth.py): fields at a fixed offset in at least 60% of a type's messages, bitfields sharing a byte merged, arrays of 3+ equal fields and variable-position content kept as one bytes field (the modbus.json convention for register arrays); types with fewer than 5 messages are omitted.
ground_truth_protocol.offset_convention: TPKT/COTP fields use wire-absolute offsets 0..6; the other types are relative to offset 7 (session layer).

message_types.description: TPKT (RFC 1006) and COTP data TPDU header carried on TCP port 102: version, reserved, length, COTP length indicator, PDU type, TPDU number / EOT. Offsets are wire-absolute.
